mapper.insert: insert into outbox_events ( id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, partition_key, schema_version, payload_json, status ) values ( #{id}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{partitionKey}, 1, #{payloadJson}, 'pending' )
mapper.select: select id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, coalesce(partition_key, aggregate_id) as partition_key, schema_version, payload_json, occurred_at from outbox_events where status = 'pending' and next_attempt_at <= current_timestamp order by created_at limit 1 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update outbox_events set status = 'processed', processed_at = current_timestamp, claimed_at = null, claimed_by = null, last_error = null where id = #{eventId}
